class.name: HTMLCanvasRenderingContext2D
class.brief_description: A GDScript-accessible 2D drawing context for an HTML canvas.
class.description: Draws into the canvas's intrinsic RGBA pixels. Fill and stroke styles accept a Godot [Color], CSS color string, [HTMLCanvasGradient], or [HTMLCanvasPattern]. A Godot [Font] resource and pixel size can be used with [method fill_text]. Supported operations include rectangles, a simple polygon path, arcs, image drawing, pixel reads and writes, and 2D transforms. Image reads and writes use Godot [Image] resources rather than browser [code]ImageData[/code].

method.name: clear_rect
method.description: Clears the transformed rectangle to transparent pixels.

method.name: fill_rect
method.description: Fills the transformed rectangle using [member fill_style].

method.name: stroke_rect
method.description: Strokes the rectangle using [member stroke_style] and [member line_width].

method.name: begin_path
method.description: Clears the current path.

method.name: close_path
method.description: Closes the current path.

method.name: move_to
method.description: Moves the current path point.

method.name: line_to
method.description: Adds a straight segment to the current path.

method.name: rect
method.description: Adds a rectangle to the current path.

method.name: arc
method.description: Adds a sampled circular arc to the current path. Angles are in radians.

method.name: fill
method.description: Fills the current path using [member fill_style].

method.name: stroke
method.description: Strokes the current path using [member stroke_style] and [member line_width].

method.name: fill_text
method.description: Draws text with the active [member font] and [member font_size]. The position's y coordinate is the text baseline.

method.name: create_linear_gradient
method.description: Creates a linear gradient from the first point to the second. Add stops with [method HTMLCanvasGradient.add_color_stop], then assign the result to [member fill_style] or [member stroke_style].

method.name: create_pattern
method.description: Creates an image pattern from an [Image], [Texture2D], or [HTMLCanvasElement]. Repeat may be [code]repeat[/code], [code]repeat-x[/code], [code]repeat-y[/code], or [code]no-repeat[/code].

method.name: save
method.description: Saves the fill style, stroke style, line width, and transform.

method.name: restore
method.description: Restores the most recently saved context state when one is available.

method.name: reset_transform
method.description: Resets the current transform to the identity transform.

method.name: translate
method.description: Translates the current transform.

method.name: scale
method.description: Scales the current transform.

method.name: rotate
method.description: Rotates the current transform in radians.

method.name: set_transform
method.description: Replaces the current transform with the affine matrix [code](a, b, c, d, e, f)[/code].

method.name: draw_image
method.description: Draws an [Image], [Texture2D], or [HTMLCanvasElement] at its intrinsic size.

method.name: draw_image_sized
method.description: Draws an image source scaled to the destination size.

method.name: draw_image_region
method.description: Draws a source rectangle into a destination rectangle.

method.name: put_image_data
method.description: Copies image pixels at integer coordinates, ignoring the current transform and compositing mode.

method.name: get_image_data
method.description: Returns a copy of the requested pixel rectangle. Pixels outside the canvas are transparent.

method.name: get_image
method.description: Returns a copy of the full backing image.

members.member: The fill [Color], CSS color string, [HTMLCanvasGradient], or [HTMLCanvasPattern].
The stroke [Color], CSS color string, [HTMLCanvasGradient], or [HTMLCanvasPattern].
The width used by stroke operations. Values must be positive.
The font resource used by [method fill_text], or [code]null[/code] to use Godot's fallback font.
The font pixel size used by [method fill_text]. Values range from 1 to 512.
